questions.question: The first playback song in Hindi Movies was recorded by music directors RC Boral and Pankaj Mullick in which year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__1935.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first playback song in Hindi movies was recorded by music directors RC Boral and Pankaj Mullick in **1935.**
 
• 85 years ago, in 1935, the first playback song was recorded, for Nitin Bose's **Dhoop Chhaon.**
 
• Before that, actors sang their own songs on the set, and the musicians played on set too, often hidden behind trees and other props.
 
• But as India became independent, the playback song too was on the brink of making history. And as often happens, fate played a role: Noorjehan went to Pakistan, leaving behind a huge void. That void was filled by Lata Mangeshkar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pankaj Kumar Mullick** was an Indian music composer, playback singer, and actor, who was a pioneer of film music in Bengali cinema and Hindi Cinema at the advent of playback singing as well as an early exponent of Rabindra Sangeet.
 
• Rai Chand Boral was an Indian composer, considered by music connoisseurs to be the Bhishma Pitamah, the father of film music in India.

questions.question: The Lucknow Gharana which came into existence in the time of Wajid Ali Shah was developed by who among the following?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Thakur Prasad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Thakur Prasad** was instrumental in developing the Lucknow Gharana during the time of Wajid Ali Shah.
 
• The Lucknow Gharana is one of the prominent schools of Kathak dance, known for its intricate footwork, graceful movements, and expressive gestures.
 
• It emphasizes storytelling through dance and has contributed significantly to the classical dance heritage of India.
 
• This Gharana has produced many renowned artists who have carried forward its rich traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Wajid Ali Shah**, the last Nawab of Awadh, was a patron of arts and played a key role in the cultural development of Lucknow, including the promotion of Kathak dance.
 
• The Lucknow Gharana is distinct from other Kathak Gharanas like the Jaipur and Banaras Gharanas, each having its own unique style and repertoire.
 
• Besides dance, the Lucknow Gharana has also influenced music, particularly the thumri style of singing.
 
• Efforts have been made to preserve and promote the traditions of the Lucknow Gharana through institutions and cultural festivals.

questions.question: Who among the following Indian singers has written ‘Raag Sarita’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Chintaman Raghunath Vyas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chintaman Raghunath Vyas**, popularly known as C. R. Vyas, was an **Indian classical singer**. He was known for singing **khyal style**.
 
• He also researched traditional **ragas and bandishes** and composed more than **200 bandishes** in different ragas under the pen-name **Gunijaan**.
 
• As a tribute to his **Guru Gunidas,** he started the **Gunidas Sangeet Sammelan **in **1977**.
 
• He has written a book **Raag Sarita** which sums up his work in the field of music.
 
• The updated edition of the book was recently released in **2019** by his son **Suhas Vyas**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pandit Kumar Gandharva**, originally known as Shivaputra Siddharamaya Komkalimath was an Indian classical singer, well known for his unique vocal style and for his refusal to be bound by the tradition of any gharana.
 
• **Balasaheb Poonchwale **was a Hindustani classical vocalist and leading figure of the Gwalior gharana. The son and disciple of Raja Bhaiya Poonchwale, he also learned from celebrated musicologists Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande and S. N. Ratanjankar.
 
• **Pandit Vishnu Narayan Bhatkhande** was an Indian musicologist who wrote the first modern treatise on Hindustani classical music, an art that had been propagated for centuries mostly through oral traditions.
